definitions.explanation: In everyday situations; what typically happens or is done.
Relating to normal, daily life as opposed to special occasions.

{普段|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧
{普段|ふだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{普段|ふだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
{普段|ふだん}⟦どおり→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spend the day as usual.
What time do you usually go to bed?

examples.english: I want to be my usual self.

{普段|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: It's different from how things usually are.

notes:
{普段|ふだん} refers to normal, everyday circumstances.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {普段|ふだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜 (usually ~)
- {普段|ふだん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧〜 (habitually; on a regular basis)
- {普段|ふだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (everyday ~; usual ~)
- {普段|ふだん}⟦どおり→通り：01475_toori⟧ (as usual)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{普段着|ふだんぎ}→普段着：15346_fudangi⟧ (everyday clothes)
- ⟦{普段使|ふだんづか}い→普段使い：27317_fudanzukai⟧ (for everyday use)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always (more frequent than {普段|ふだん})
- ⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧: usually, mostly
- ⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧: normally (more formal)
- ⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧: daily, everyday (noun)

NUANCE:
- {普段|ふだん} implies contrast with special occasions
- Often used when comparing normal behavior to exceptions
